sources.quote: HD 17156 b, named Mulchatna by the IAU, is an extrasolar planet approximately 255 light-years away in the constellation of Cassiopeia.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HD 17156. Its orbit and size follow Kane et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
